evidence.title: LightSprint docs
evidence.locator: Tasks; Agents; Review Hub; task tracking
evidence.finding: The public docs define tasks, cloud agent work and Review Hub as the hosted product workflow.

evidence.title: LightSprint agents-doc
evidence.locator: Launching an agent; during a run; session interface; files changed
evidence.finding: Docs name Claude, Codex and Pi engines, sandbox/branch lifecycle and actual before/after file reading in the session. Engine/model descriptions do not expose the underlying executable adapter.

evidence.title: LightSprint agent-subscriptions
evidence.locator: Available engines; Connect a personal subscription; Claude connection; run-as
evidence.finding: Personal Claude OAuth/setup-token, ChatGPT subscriptions and OpenRouter API keys can fund tasks independently of workspace credits. Pi appears after an OpenRouter key is saved.

evidence.title: LightSprint tasks-doc
evidence.locator: How a task moves; Task details; description/timeline; linked dependencies
evidence.finding: Product-owned tasks have permanent references, Backlog/Todo/In Progress/In Review/Done state, editable briefs/timeline and linked PRs. Dependencies are displayed rather than launch enforcement.

evidence.title: LightSprint guardrails
evidence.locator: Agent boundaries; permission modes; roles; rule defaults
evidence.finding: Docs explicitly place coding work in cloud VMs on ls/* branches. Tool policies and merge roles differ; Claude read-only MCP/read-tool narrowing has documented enforcement limitations.

evidence.title: LightSprint review-doc
evidence.locator: Review Hub; role table; merge policy; merge agent rules
evidence.finding: Product opens/links PRs, supports human/authorized auto-merge, has latest-commit review rules and preserves branch protection/required checks and merge queues. Merge agent cannot approve its own changes.

evidence.title: LightSprint automations
evidence.finding: Product automations own schedule and connected event triggers, run-as user credentials, concurrency limits and versioned Activity history.

evidence.title: LightSprint pricing
evidence.finding: Current public plans show Free $0/month with 5 tasks/plans weekly, Pro $40/month/seat with 10M shared credits per seat and BYO subscription/key routes, and Enterprise custom pricing.

evidence.title: LightSprint privacy
evidence.locator: Effective date 2025-03-17; Usage/device data; Cookies; AI models/subprocessors
evidence.finding: Policy explicitly says the service automatically collects pages/features/IP/browser/device/timestamp usage for product analytics. Browser cookie controls are described; no product-wide telemetry stop control is established.

evidence.title: LightSprint billing-doc
evidence.locator: Plans; Free allowance; seat count; personal funding
evidence.finding: Billing docs state Free is single-member with no recurring credits,5 creations per rolling7 days, BYO personal funding after the starter allowance, and Pro seats up to 50. The pricing page says 20, an unresolved cap discrepancy.

evidence.title: LightSprint parallel-doc
evidence.finding: Official documentation describes multiple tasks on a common base with separate task changes and merge ordering. This is not a concurrency measurement.
